acceptance_scope: Offline active-network correction implementation and historical MODELLED derivation only; not installed policy applicability, preparation readiness, or operational authorization.

scope_distinction.method: Direct inspection of the correction, prior reviewed hashes, and in-memory reverse transformations; no broad dirty-worktree diff or architecture re-audit.
scope_distinction.adapter: V2 branch, review binding, digest dispatch, diagnostic envelope and unchanged raw inventory/preservation paths inspected directly; no whole-file reverse-hash proof claimed.
scope_distinction.frozen_hash_checks: Old assembler, accepted v6b runtime review, historical failure review, and three historical producer inputs retain their prior hashes. These old acceptances are not reissued or made applicable to changed consumers.

shown.evidence: companion-runtime-pins-v2 requires exactly the manifest fields including network_configuration; configuration requires exactly contract/bindings, configured-network-v1 and validated immutable bindings. Manifest bytes, subjects, dependency records and topical approval digest remain externally hash-bound. Loader requires the reviewed bindings to equal the preparation plan.

shown.claim: Producer and loader use the same final-model contract
shown.evidence: final_subject delegates to final_model and configured project; loader uses final_model and the same project for V2 application preservation pins. Declared aliases replace the predicted set exactly. Extra observed aliases are not stripped. Alias order/deduplication follows the pre-existing preservation algorithm.

shown.claim: Narrow configured digest, not a raw inventory rewrite
shown.evidence: Only V2 application pin comparisons in compatibility and _target use configured project. inventory(), installer snapshot comparisons, legacy/raw preservation functions, staged raw comparisons and storage pin digests remain raw. V1 policy checks retain their original field set and boolean-map compatibility return shape.

shown.claim: Configured-only observation is restricted and not attachment proof
shown.evidence: Blank observed NetworkID is permitted for V2 application pin comparison only in created state with never-started timestamp, zero exact-int restarts and restart policy no. Wrong IDs, unknown network names and contradictory endpoint/address evidence refuse. Configured recipient checks retain fresh network identity verification and existing ports/DNS/volume/alias-exclusivity checks. Post-start recipient_checks still requires real attachment before application health/query HTTP.

shown.claim: IPAM and aliases remain fail closed
shown.evidence: Only null and empty-dict IPAM representations are equivalent. Nonempty static IPAM remains fingerprinted. Unexpected aliases, including daemon-generated names or IDs not explicitly declared, produce a mismatch rather than an equivalence assumption.

V2 early-precondition failures expose an allowlisted category and optional selected target alongside checks. Installer independently filters category/target and serializes only allowlisted keys as literal boolean success values. False is explicitly labelled not_established_or_not_evaluated. Exceptions/timeouts yield a fixed marker without exception text. Tests verify publication ordering and synthetic private-value exclusion. complete means the early-precondition path completed, not that every check passed.

shown.claim: Historical output is inert and reproducible
shown.evidence: Three frozen input hashes verified. Independent JavaScript translation of the inspected Python preservation/projection algorithms reconstructs the saved historical counterfactual byte-for-byte, including final newline, SHA256 16be0551161056533bb3cceecf2acb6e2c9913df15504b7a34ea2d3873daf6e6. Seven subjects retained; three storage subjects unchanged, all identities/images/source maps unchanged, only four application preservation digests replaced. Output explicitly MODELLED, INCOMPLETE, historical_removed_ids_only, runtime_authorized=false, policy_approval_created=false.

verification.coverage: New active-network tests; saved network projection and loader regressions; synthetic real-adapter/installer composition; selected legacy policy-binding, empty-review and diagnostic-before-cleanup regressions.
verification.excluded: No full suite, Docker/native container operations, credential reads, service/process lifecycle actions or live network requests. The existing bash subprocess test and unrelated adapter tests were not selected.

parent_result.classification: CLAIMED by parent and recorded in checkpoint; not independently rerun

verification.artifact_reproduction: Independent in-memory reconstruction, not a native capture and not a second producer command.

remaining_limits.detail: Lost activated v6b rows do not establish their complete alias set or the exact historical failing predicate. The correction does not upgrade candidate causation to observed causation.

Complete declared alias set remains MODELLED. Future genuinely fresh prepared IDs need actual alias-configuration evidence and independent exact-ID/policy review before an operational packet is accepted. An unexpected daemon alias will intentionally fail closed.
No live daemon lifecycle, attachment, startup, recovery, health, citation/query or economic behavior was verified by this review. Configured equivalence is not connectivity or liveness.

Historical candidate IDs are consumed/removed and cannot be reused. Changed source hashes invalidate prior current-consumer bindings; old runtime and policy records confer no refreshed applicability or operation authority.
Diagnostic booleans are bounded gate outcomes, not a complete evaluation trace. False may mean unevaluated; exception/timeout markers do not disclose the exact underlying predicate.
